gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-supreme: Love Ya Like A Sister has a flat, low-slung beat, with ascenders that barely clear the x-height and terminals that flick outward. Supreme follows in a heavier, crisp plain sans, its letters held open instead of curling shut.
gen-nixie-one-fs-plein: Nixie One draws open curves with clear gaps, one hairline stroke running from top to baseline. Plein is the sturdier of the two, a reliable sans-serif whose round letters each get a clear channel in.
gen-nixie-one-fs-roundo: Roundo reads as a tidy geometric sans, its n built with arch and stem matching and every small counter left unclogged. Nixie One gets the nostalgic, retro-tech flourish up top, while Roundo does the steady everyday work below.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-hind: Fun is the first thing Press Start 2P hands over, with big open bowls and letters spaced like cut-outs pinned far apart. Hind then carries on steadily, its lowercase close to the capitals and its strokes drawn like taut string.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Roomy, regal, a bit odd. Metamorphous sets a high midline and a soft brush-like shift in its strokes, while Pilcrow Rounded sits beside it warm and tight-spaced, with parallel edges running through every curve.
gen-righteous-fs-hind: Righteous bends what looks like thin steel rod into bowls that fill the line, and it earns its keep big and short. Hind sits below as a plain sans, its lowercase close to the capitals and its c never turning inward.
gen-silkscreen-outfit: Silkscreen lays its letters out like spaghetti, each one wrapped in space you can almost feel. And Outfit, a clean, friendly sans bent like cable, is the one whose size you can nudge freely for comfort.
gen-silkscreen-space-grotesk: Retro and lo-fi, Silkscreen leaves so much space around each letter that headings seem to float. Space Grotesk follows smoothly, its open counters and ribbon-like strokes easy going.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Stencil cuts, tall letters, loud attitude. Snowburst One handles the shouting with wide bridges and tall lowercase, and Pilcrow Rounded handles the talking, a warm sans with straight-edged, constant strokes and wide counters.
gen-zen-dots-fs-spline-sans: Friendly and techy, Zen Dots gives every letter plenty of room, with openings that stay generous at each weight, and Spline Sans follows in kind. Both keep their curves wide open.
